changes.new_desc: Finds subscribers in one list whose custom field values match exactly, e.g. {"CITY": "Rome"}; with several fields all must match. Use it for ad-hoc lookups; use search_subscriber_by_email for an email address and create_list_segment for a reusable filter. Paginated; read-only.

changes.old_desc: Search a subscriber by email across all lists visible to the customer.
changes.new_desc: Finds an email address across ALL lists of the account and returns every match with its list, subscriber_uid and status. Use it when the list is unknown (e.g. privacy or opt-out requests); use search_subscriber_by_email when you know the list. Read-only.

changes.old_desc: Search a subscriber by email in one MailSenpai list.
changes.new_desc: Checks whether an email address is in ONE given list and returns its subscriber_uid and status; an error saying the subscriber does not exist means not found. Use search_subscriber_by_email_all_lists when you do not know the list. Read-only.

changes.old_desc: Schedule an existing campaign by setting send_at and status=pending-sending. Requires confirm_send=true and approval_reference when required by plan.
changes.new_desc: Schedules an existing draft campaign for real sending at send_at (status becomes pending-sending). Use reschedule_campaign to move an already scheduled campaign and cancel_scheduled_campaign to stop it before it starts. Ask the user to approve, then call with confirm_send=true.

changes.old_desc: Change send_at for a scheduled campaign. Requires confirm_send=true and approval_reference when required by plan.
changes.new_desc: Changes the send date and time of a campaign that is already scheduled (it stays pending-sending). Use schedule_campaign_send for a draft that is not scheduled yet. Requires confirm_send=true after the user approves the new time.

changes.old_desc: Toggle pause/unpause for a MailSenpai campaign.
changes.new_desc: Toggles a campaign between sending and paused: a sending campaign is paused, a paused campaign RESUMES sending. Check the current status with get_campaign first and confirm with the user, because resuming restarts delivery.

changes.old_desc: Mark a campaign as sent. Requires confirm_send=true because it changes campaign lifecycle state.
changes.new_desc: Marks a campaign as sent, which permanently stops any remaining delivery; it cannot be resumed afterwards. Use it only to close a stuck or abandoned campaign, after explicit user confirmation, with confirm_send=true.

changes.old_desc: List unsubscribed subscribers for a MailSenpai list.
changes.new_desc: Lists the subscribers of a list with status unsubscribed (opted out; kept for history and no longer emailed). Shortcut for search_subscribers_by_status with status=unsubscribed. Paginated; read-only.

changes.old_desc: List unconfirmed subscribers for a MailSenpai list.
changes.new_desc: Lists the subscribers of a list with status unconfirmed (signed up but not yet confirmed, so they do not receive campaigns). Shortcut for search_subscribers_by_status with status=unconfirmed. Paginated; read-only.

changes.old_desc: List MailSenpai templates.
changes.new_desc: Lists the saved email templates of the account (template_uid, name, screenshot) page by page. Use search_templates to filter by name and get_template for the full HTML. Paginated; read-only.

changes.old_desc: List subscribers for a MailSenpai list. Status is optional.
changes.new_desc: Lists the subscribers of one list page by page, optionally filtered by status; each record has subscriber_uid, email, custom field values, status, source and date added. To find one person use search_subscriber_by_email; to filter by field values use search_subscribers_by_custom_fields. Paginated; r

changes.old_desc: List subscribers belonging to a segment.
changes.new_desc: Returns the subscribers that currently match a saved segment (subscriber_uid, email, status, field values). Use list_subscribers for the whole list, or search_subscribers_by_custom_fields for a one-off filter without saving a segment. Paginated; read-only.

changes.old_desc: List all supported segment condition operators.
changes.new_desc: Returns the operators that segment conditions can use (operator_id, name and slug such as contains or greater-than). Read-only, no parameters.

changes.old_desc: List segments for a MailSenpai list.
changes.new_desc: Lists the segments (saved subscriber filters) of one list with each segment_uid and name. Use get_list_segment for the conditions and list_segment_subscribers to see who matches. Paginated; read-only.

changes.old_desc: List mailing lists visible to the authenticated customer.
changes.new_desc: Lists the account's mailing lists page by page, with each list's list_uid, name and display name. Use it to find the list_uid that most other tools need; use get_list for the full settings of one list. Returns data.records plus count and total_pages. Read-only.

changes.old_desc: List available MailSenpai custom field types.
changes.new_desc: Returns the custom field types that create_list_field accepts (identifier and name, e.g. text, dropdown, date). Read-only, no parameters.

changes.old_desc: List custom fields for a MailSenpai list.
changes.new_desc: Lists the custom fields of one list (for example EMAIL, FNAME, LNAME) with each field's field_id, tag, label, type and required flag. Use it to learn the tags for subscriber data and the field_id needed in segment conditions. Paginated; read-only.

changes.old_desc: List zones/states for a country ID.
changes.new_desc: Lists the zones (states, provinces, regions) of one country by country_id from list_countries. Paginated; read-only.

changes.old_desc: List countries available in MailSenpai.
changes.new_desc: Lists the countries known to MailSenpai with country_id, name and code, used for address details (e.g. a list's company info) and to look up zones with list_country_zones. Paginated; read-only.

changes.old_desc: List confirmed subscribers for a MailSenpai list.
changes.new_desc: Lists the subscribers of a list with status confirmed, i.e. the active contacts who receive campaigns. Shortcut for search_subscribers_by_status with status=confirmed. Paginated; read-only.

changes.old_desc: List MailSenpai campaigns, optionally filtered by list UID.
changes.new_desc: Lists the account's campaigns page by page with campaign_uid, name, type and status (draft, pending-sending, sending, sent, paused...), optionally only those of one list. Use get_campaign for the details and get_campaign_stats for the results. Paginated; read-only.

changes.old_desc: List bounces recorded for a campaign.
changes.new_desc: Lists the individual bounces recorded for one campaign: subscriber, bounce type (hard, soft or internal) and the receiving server's message. Use get_campaign_stats for totals only. Paginated; read-only.

changes.old_desc: List blacklisted subscribers for a MailSenpai list.
changes.new_desc: Lists the subscribers of a list with status blacklisted (blocked: they never receive emails, e.g. after complaints or hard bounces). Shortcut for search_subscribers_by_status with status=blacklisted. Paginated; read-only.

changes.old_desc: Get one transactional email by email UID.
changes.new_desc: Returns one transactional email by email_uid with recipient, sender, subject, status and sending details. Read-only.

changes.old_desc: Get one MailSenpai template by UID.
changes.new_desc: Returns one saved email template by template_uid, including its name and full HTML content. Read-only.

changes.old_desc: Get one subscriber by subscriber UID in a list.
changes.new_desc: Returns one subscriber by subscriber_uid with email, all custom field values, status, source, IP address and date added. If you only have the email address use search_subscriber_by_email first. Read-only.

changes.old_desc: Get a segment by segment UID for a list.
changes.new_desc: Returns one segment by segment_uid with its name, match mode (all or any) and conditions. Use list_segment_subscribers to see the matching subscribers. Read-only.

changes.old_desc: Get one custom field by field ID for a list.
changes.new_desc: Returns one custom field of a list by field_id: label, tag, type, required flag, default value and options (for dropdowns). Use list_list_fields to find the field_id. Read-only.

changes.old_desc: Get one list by list UID.
changes.new_desc: Returns the full settings of one mailing list by list_uid: general info, default sender (from name, from email, reply-to), notification and company details. If you only know the list name, find its list_uid with list_lists first. Read-only.

changes.old_desc: Get aggregate MailSenpai statistics for a campaign.
changes.new_desc: Returns the aggregate results of one campaign: recipients processed, delivered, opens and unique opens, clicks, hard/soft bounces, unsubscribes and complaints, with rates. For the individual bounce records use list_campaign_bounces. Read-only.

changes.old_desc: Get one MailSenpai campaign by campaign UID.
changes.new_desc: Returns one campaign by campaign_uid: name, subject, sender, list and segment, status and send date. For opens, clicks and bounces use get_campaign_stats. Read-only.

changes.old_desc: Deletes a transactional email. Requires delete permission on the account and confirm_delete=true.
changes.new_desc: Permanently deletes a transactional email record by email_uid; this cannot be undone. Ask the user for explicit confirmation, then call with confirm_delete=true.

changes.old_desc: Permanently deletes a template. Requires delete permission on the account and confirm_delete=true.
changes.new_desc: Permanently deletes a saved template; campaigns that already used it keep their content. Ask the user for explicit confirmation, then call with confirm_delete=true.

changes.old_desc: Finds and deletes a subscriber by email. Requires delete permission on the account and confirm_delete=true.
changes.new_desc: Same as delete_subscriber, but first finds the address in the given list. Permanent; for a simple opt-out use unsubscribe_subscriber_by_email. Ask the user for explicit confirmation, then call with confirm_delete=true.

changes.old_desc: Deletes a subscriber by UID. Requires delete permission on the account and confirm_delete=true.
changes.new_desc: Permanently deletes a subscriber (by subscriber_uid) and its history from a list; this cannot be undone. To stop emails while keeping the record use unsubscribe_subscriber instead. Ask the user for explicit confirmation, then call with confirm_delete=true.

changes.old_desc: Deletes a segment. Requires delete permission on the account and confirm_delete=true.
changes.new_desc: Permanently deletes a saved segment; the subscribers themselves are kept. Ask the user for explicit confirmation, then call with confirm_delete=true.

changes.old_desc: Permanently deletes a custom field. Requires delete permission on the account and confirm_delete=true.
changes.new_desc: Permanently deletes a custom field from a list, together with the values stored in it for every subscriber; this cannot be undone. Ask the user for explicit confirmation, then call with confirm_delete=true.

changes.old_desc: Permanently deletes a list. Requires delete permission on the account and confirm_delete=true.
changes.new_desc: Permanently deletes a mailing list together with all its subscribers, custom fields and segments; this cannot be undone. Ask the user for explicit confirmation, then call with confirm_delete=true. Only available if the plan allows deletions.

changes.old_desc: Permanently deletes a campaign. Requires delete permission on the account and confirm_delete=true.
changes.new_desc: Permanently deletes a campaign and its statistics; this cannot be undone. To stop a campaign but keep it use cancel_scheduled_campaign or pause_unpause_campaign. Ask the user for explicit confirmation, then call with confirm_delete=true.

changes.old_desc: Creates or schedules a transactional email. Requires transactional sending permission on the account. Email data follows the MailSenpai API format, including optional attachments with base64 data.
changes.new_desc: Sends one transactional email to a single recipient, queued for immediate delivery or for send_at. It is a real send: show the user the recipient and content and call with confirm_send=true only after approval. To email a whole list use a campaign instead.

changes.old_desc: Create a template. Provide template.name and template.content or template.archive; inline_css is optional.
changes.new_desc: Saves a new reusable email template from HTML (or a ZIP archive) and returns its template_uid, which create_campaign can use. It does not create or send any campaign.

changes.old_desc: Create a subscriber in a list. Data must contain EMAIL and any custom fields.
changes.new_desc: Adds a new subscriber to a list and returns its subscriber_uid. Fails if the email is already in the list: use create_or_update_subscriber to add-or-update, or bulk_create_subscribers for many contacts at once. Depending on the list's opt-in setting the new subscriber may start as unconfirmed.

changes.old_desc: Creates a campaign directly as pending-sending. Requires confirm_send=true and, where the plan requires it, approval_reference.
changes.new_desc: Creates a campaign and schedules it for real sending in one step (status pending-sending at campaign.send_at). To prepare a draft for review use create_campaign instead. Ask the user to approve list, content and send time, then call with confirm_send=true (plus approval_reference if the plan require

changes.old_desc: Create a subscriber or update it if it already exists. Data must contain EMAIL.
changes.new_desc: Upsert: looks up data.EMAIL in the list; if found it updates that subscriber, otherwise it creates a new one. Use it to sync contacts when you do not know whether they already exist. Existing values are overwritten, so confirm with the user before updating real contacts.

changes.old_desc: Creates a list segment from data with top-level name, operator_match and conditions. Each condition requires field_id, operator_id and value; operator slugs such as not-contains are accepted and mapped automatically.
changes.new_desc: Creates a saved segment in a list from field conditions (and optional campaign open/click conditions) and returns its segment_uid. Get field_id values from list_list_fields and operators from list_segment_condition_operators.

changes.old_desc: Creates a custom field. Accepts data.type (for example text/dropdown), data.label and an optional data.tag. The field payload is normalized and the field type is sent in the position the API requires.
changes.new_desc: Adds a new custom field to a list (e.g. a "City" text field or a "Plan" dropdown) and returns it. Valid type identifiers come from list_list_field_types. Existing subscribers start with the new field empty.

changes.old_desc: Creates a list. Accepts data.general and data.defaults; the optional data.notifications and data.company follow the MailSenpai API format.
changes.new_desc: Creates a new, empty mailing list and returns its list_uid. To duplicate an existing list with its custom fields and segments use copy_list instead; to add contacts afterwards use create_subscriber or bulk_create_subscribers.

changes.old_desc: Creates a MailSenpai campaign. It is created as a draft unless status=pending-sending is set, which requires confirm_send=true and, where the plan requires it, approval_reference. Accepts either a complete campaign object or the common flat fields.
changes.new_desc: Creates a new campaign, by default as a DRAFT that sends nothing. Needs list_uid, name, subject, from_name, from_email, reply_to, send_at and content (template_uid or template_content HTML). To duplicate a past campaign use copy_campaign; to create and schedule in one step use create_scheduled_campa

changes.old_desc: Copy a list by list UID. This creates a duplicate list in MailSenpai.
changes.new_desc: Creates a copy of a list with its settings, custom fields and segments (subscribers are NOT copied) and returns the new list_uid; the copy's name gets a "#1"-style suffix. Use create_list instead to start an empty list from scratch.

changes.old_desc: Copy/duplicate a campaign by campaign UID.
changes.new_desc: Duplicates an existing campaign (list, segment, content and settings) into a new DRAFT without send date and returns the new campaign_uid; the copy's name gets a "#1"-style suffix. Use it to reuse a past campaign; use create_campaign to start from scratch. Nothing is sent.

changes.old_desc: Finds a subscriber by email and sets its status to confirmed, which confirms an unconfirmed subscriber or resubscribes an unsubscribed one.
changes.new_desc: Same as confirm_subscriber, but first finds the subscriber by email in the given list. Re-subscribing someone who opted out requires their consent, so confirm with the user first.

changes.old_desc: Sets a MailSenpai subscriber status to confirmed by UID, which confirms an unconfirmed subscriber or resubscribes an unsubscribed one. Sends details[status]=confirmed to the MailSenpai API.
changes.new_desc: Sets a subscriber's status to confirmed by subscriber_uid: confirms an unconfirmed contact or re-subscribes one who unsubscribed, so they receive campaigns again. Do this only with the contact's consent and after the user confirms. Use confirm_subscriber_by_email if you only have the address.

changes.old_desc: Move a scheduled campaign back to draft when supported by the MailSenpai API.
changes.new_desc: Stops a scheduled campaign before it starts by moving it back to draft; nothing is deleted and it can be scheduled again later. For a campaign that is already sending use pause_unpause_campaign. Confirm with the user first.

changes.old_desc: Bulk-creates subscribers in one list. Each row must contain EMAIL. The plan's maximum number of rows per bulk import is enforced.
changes.new_desc: Adds many subscribers to one list in a single call and returns the outcome for each row. The number of rows is capped by the plan (usually 500 per call); split bigger imports. Use create_subscriber for a single contact.
